name: huangque-canvas-linear
label: 黄雀画布线性图标
preamble: Premium minimal line icons for Huangque's dark AI creation canvas: crisp silver-white outlines, uniform rounded strokes, restrained geometry, generous negative space, and one tiny warm-gold four-point sparrow sparkle as a recurring brand signature. No tile, no container, no text, no fill, no shadow or glow.

construction.grid: 24-unit keyline; live area 76%; 12% optical padding; circles may be slightly larger than squares
construction.stroke: uniform 2.1-unit silver-white stroke with rounded caps and joins
construction.detail_budget: one core metaphor and no more than four elements per icon
construction.color_rule: silver-white carries the icon; warm gold appears only as one very small secondary sparkle
construction.shared_parts: reuse one canonical image frame, play triangle, plus, document and sparkle
construction.motif: one tiny four-point sparrow sparkle placed near the upper-right edge when it does not obscure the metaphor
construction.weight_hierarchy: the silver-white defining stroke stays visually heavier than the smaller gold sparkle

fits: Huangque canvas creation menu, context actions and future toolbox headers.
